```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
```


```{r}
files <- list.files(path = "/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/Robo/07102025")

robo <- data.frame()

for (file in files){
  name <- gsub(".csv","", file)
  robo_file <- read_csv(paste("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/Robo/07102025/",file, sep = ""))
  robo_file <- robo_file[-c(1:20), ]
  robo_file$sensor <- name
  robo <- rbind(robo, robo_file)
}

colnames(robo) <- c("datetime", "temp", "robo_sensor")

```


```{r}
robo_sensor_key <- read_excel("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/robo_sensor_key.xlsx")
robo_sensor_key$robo_sensor <- as.character(robo_sensor_key$robo_sensor)
robo$robo_sensor <- as.character(robo$robo_sensor)
robo$temp <- as.numeric(robo$temp)

robo <- left_join(robo, robo_sensor_key, by = "robo_sensor")
robo$bag <- as.factor(robo$bag)

robo$datetime <- as.POSIXct(robo$datetime, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "America/Los_Angeles")

robo$datetime <- robo$datetime - hours(7)

```


```{r}
ggplot(robo, aes(x=datetime, y=temp, colour = robo_sensor))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()

```

```{r}
robo %>%
  filter(bag == c(43:46, 27:30))%>%
  filter(density == "D")%>%
  filter(top_bottom == c("1", "2"))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime, y=temp, colour = top_bottom, linetype = bag))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
robo %>%
  filter(bag == c(93:100))%>%
  filter(density == "D")%>%
  filter(top_bottom == c("1", "2"))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime, y=temp, colour = top_bottom, linetype = bag))+
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("Bottom", "Top"), values = c("steelblue", "tomato"))+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"))+
  labs(color = "Bag Position",
       x = "Date", 
       y = "Temperature (°C)")+
  geom_line(aes(linetype = bag))+
  theme_classic()
```
